newsitem.title: USA: HBO & Co to buy Management Software Inc.
newsitem.headline: HBO & Co to buy Management Software Inc.

text.p: HBO & Co said Wednesday it reached a definitive agreement to acquire Management Software Inc (MSI), a privately held provider of software solutions for the home care industry.

MSI shareholders will receive about 890,000 shares of HBOC stock. The acquisition is subject to regulatory approval and will be accounted for as a pooling of interests. It is expected to close in the third quarter, HBO & Co said.
Shares of HBO & Co settled with a gain of 3/4 at 55-1/2 in Nasdaq trading on Tuesday.
